## Upgrade the gateway

Upgrade one gateway pod at a time, so the other pods keep routing traffic.

Before you start, check these prerequisites:

List (2 of 2 items, style=unordered)
Location: Gateway operations > Upgrade the gateway
[1] A Kubernetes cluster in version 1.29 or later.
[2] Helm in version 3.14 or later.

To upgrade the gateway, follow these steps:

List (3 of 3 items, style=ordered)
Location: Gateway operations > Upgrade the gateway
[1] 1. Back up the gateway configuration with `kubectl get configmap gateway-config -o yaml > backup.yaml`.
[2] 2. Install the gateway Helm chart in version 1.7.0.
[3] 3. Check that every gateway pod reports `Ready` with `kubectl get pods -l app=gateway`.

If a pod stays in `CrashLoopBackOff` for more than five minutes, roll back with `helm rollback gateway`.

List (2 of 2 items, style=unordered)
Location: Gateway operations > Upgrade the gateway > Rollback checks
[1] Confirm the previous chart version with `helm history gateway`.
[2] Check that the user sessions recover within two minutes.

Sub-sections (1):
  - Log settings (chunk_id=log-settings)
